description: Fixture-only oracle separating runtime acquisition stability, evidence readiness, and offline retrieval quality. Runtime envelopes must not expose TP/FP/FN metrics.

gateModel.answerabilityNative: C/C++ native Judge answer packets validate verdict/status, Source Code KG evidence, Threat KB affectedness, controls, and grounded unknown semantics.
gateModel.evidenceReadiness: consumer policies determine whether S3/S4 may use returned material as context, diagnostics, scoped negative evidence, or local-support references
gateModel.judgeAnswerability: Expected answer packets are S5 evidence-grounded knowledge verdicts, not S3 final vulnerability/security verdicts.
gateModel.nativeNegativeCases: Adversarial cases prevent risk-signal proof, keyword/vector no-hit proof, CPE false positives, stale evidence, distro/backport, vendored source, and excluded-CVE resurrection overclaims.
gateModel.qualityGate: offline-only retrieval/transform metrics over expectedCandidateIds and retrievedCandidateIds
gateModel.systemStability: manifest loads, schema validates, and acquisition statuses remain contract vocabulary
